title: Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.20814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often trains language models on responses generated by a different, possibly stale behavior policy. Correcting this mismatch with learner-to-behavior importance weights can introduce high variance for long responses. We introduce Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization (GGPO), which minimizes a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards among responses to the same prompt, without learner-to-behavior importance weights. We derive GGPO from KL-regularized policy optimization: on policy, its population loss is exactly the KL-regularized optimality gap, and under suitable coverage the learner's single-response expected reward is at least the behavior policy's best-of-$K$ reward, minus terms for the raw finite-group loss, regularization, and finite training data. translated_title: 面向可验证奖励离策略强化学习的Gibbs间隙策略优化
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习通常使用由另一个可能过时的行为策略所生成的响应来训练语言模型。用从学习策略到行为策略的重要性权重来纠正这种不匹配，会给长响应带来高方差。我们提出了Gibbs间隙策略优化（GGPO），它在无需学习策略到行为策略重要性权重的情况下，最小化同一提示下各响应之间经KL调整后的奖励的log-mean-exp（对数-均值-指数）对比。我们从KL正则化策略优化中推导出GGPO：在同策略情形下，其总体损失恰好就是KL正则化的最优性间隙；并且在适当的覆盖条件下，学习策略的单响应期望奖励至少不低亍行为策略的best-of-K奖励，只需减去原始有限组损失、正则化以及有限训练数据所带来的相应项。我们通过精确的Gibbs目标复合来刻画参考策略的刷新机制，并在局部参考……条件下给出了有限数据下最终策略的奖励上界。（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了Gibbs间隙策略优化（GGPO）——一种无需学习策略到行为策略重要性权重的离策略强化学习方法，它通过最小化同一提示下各响应经KL调整后的奖励的log-mean-exp对比进行训练，并从理论上保证学习策略的单响应期望奖励不低于行为策略的best-of-K奖励。
en_tdlr: GGPO is an off-policy RL method for verifiable rewards that eliminates high-variance learner-to-behavior importance weights by minimizing a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards among responses to the same prompt, with theoretical guarantees that the learner's single-response expected reward is at least the behavior policy's best-of-K reward.
